title: Arrival question
description: The operator's question to a reserve of what arrived at one of its accounts for an order, signed with the deployment's operator key (REQ-ORD-23). It names its own transaction, fresh for the order it is asked for, so the answer names it and counts only as that transaction's (REQ-ORD-1); the reserve asked; the holder's session, since what arrived at an account tells whether its funds suffice for that much (REQ-CAT-3, REQ-CAT-4); the account, the outer node and the asset. It names no order: Core's log binds the question to the order it is asked for, as it binds every operation. The reserve answers with its arrival answer (urn:rutent:provider-role:arrival-answer), naming this transaction and carrying its arrival notice of each credit whole.

transaction.description: The question's own transaction, fresh for the order it is asked for: every answer names it (REQ-ORD-1).

session.description: The session of the account's holder or their delegate (REQ-CAT-3): what arrived tells whether the account's funds suffice for that much, so it counts as a balance check (REQ-CAT-4), outside the bound only for the holder's own order.

node.description: The reserve's outer node, by its network.
